create.name: Centro Studi Tibetani Tenzin Ciö Ling
create.bio:
Centro Studi Tibetani Tenzin Ciö Ling is a Tibetan Buddhist study and practice centre in Sondrio, in the Valtellina valley of northern Italy. It began in 1989, inspired by the Tibetan teacher Geshe Tenzin Gompo, and follows the Mahayana and Vajrayana tradition of Tibet; its spiritual guide is Thamthog Rinpoche, and it belongs to the Italian Buddhist Union. Over the years it has hosted public talks by visiting lamas, Tibetan folk dance, sand mandalas made by monks and many courses, and it sets out to keep Tibetan culture, philosophy and language alive while encouraging dialogue between cultures.

Members can join free weekly sessions open to beginners and experienced practitioners alike: an early Monday meditation on the awakening mind, a Tuesday walking meditation, a Wednesday evening meeting on Buddhism that can also be followed on Zoom, and a guided analytical meditation on Fridays. Through the year visiting teachers such as Geshe Jampa Thinley, a Sera Jey Lharampa geshe, and Othok Rinpoche give teachings on the Lam Rim, mind training and other core subjects. The centre also runs yoga, tai chi and qigong classes. Its YouTube channel holds recordings of these teachings, including talks on karma, the four noble truths and training the mind in daily life.
